name: future-solar-crm
description: Future Solar CRM — lead-to-order, compliance and post-sale platform for the Indian solar channel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @solar/api" "npm run dev -w @solar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solar/shared --if-present && npm run build -w @solar/api && npm run build -w @solar/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @solar/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @solar/api && npm run test -w @solar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @solar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @solar/api && npm run typecheck -w @solar/web
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build:edge && npx supabase functions deploy api --no-verify-jwt
